Nothing asks whether the filer is a U.S. citizen living in one of the listed treaty countries, which would make the benefits exempt. Nothing asks about the extra Italian-citizenship condition, and no refusal covers this case. The nonresident-alien refusal handled elsewhere does not apply, because these filers are U.S. citizens. As encoded, such a filer's benefits would flow through lines 1–18 and could be taxed on line 6b.
